attempts.text:
This plan rescues the 2 elderly people and 2 children and defers the 1 adult.

- **Route:** The Myagang–Nilkantha road is impassable, so the car goes Myagang → Uttargaya → Nilkantha → Syaphru and returns the same way. That is 67 minutes each way, 134 in total.
- **Capacity:** The car holds 4. Carrying all 5 people at once is impossible, so one person must be deferred.
- **Who to defer:** Deferring the adult costs 20, the cheapest penalty. Rescuing the elderly people and the children gives a full load of 4.

Alternatives I checked:

| Option | Cost |
|---|---|
| Rescue the children first, then make a second trip for Syaphru | 190 |
| Rescue only the children and defer all 3 at Syaphru | 176 |
| Chosen plan | 154 |
| Defer everyone | 240 |

<plan>
drive car1 myagang-shelter uttargaya-school
drive car1 uttargaya-school nilkantha-market
drive car1 nilkantha-market syaphru-temple
load car1 elderly 2
defer syaphru-temple adult 1
drive car1 syaphru-temple nilkantha-market
drive car1 nilkantha-market uttargaya-school
load car1 child 2
drive car1 uttargaya-school myagang-shelter
unload car1 elderly 2
unload car1 child 2
</plan>
COST: 154
